hang on: Hang on a minute while I find a pen to write down your phone number.
请稍等一下,我找支笔把你的电话号码记下来。
close down: The old factory closed down last year, and many workers had to find new jobs.
那家老工厂去年关闭了,许多工人不得不另找工作。
a chess set: My uncle gave me a beautiful chess set for my birthday, and we played all afternoon.
我叔叔送了我一副漂亮的国际象棋作为生日礼物,我们下了整整一个下午。
chopstick: Using a chopstick to pick up rice is difficult for someone who has never tried it.
对从没试过的人来说,用一根筷子夹米饭是很难的。
video game: He spends too much time playing his new video game instead of doing his homework.
他花太多时间玩新的电子游戏,而不是做家庭作业。
for the first time: She flew on a plane for the first time last summer and was excited all the way.
她去年夏天第一次坐飞机,一路上都很兴奋。
fish and chips: We bought some fish and chips and ate them on the beach by the sea.
我们买了些炸鱼薯条,在海边的沙滩上吃了起来。
first aid: Every student should learn basic first aid so they can help if an accident happens.
每个学生都应该学一些基本急救知识,这样出了事故才能帮上忙。
at the bottom of: There was a small tear at the bottom of his jacket after the long walk.
长途步行之后,他夹克的底部破了一个小口子。
What's wrong with ⋯?: What's wrong with your bike? It looks like the front wheel is loose.
你的自行车怎么了?前轮好像松了。
lift up: Please lift up the box carefully so you don't hurt your back.
请小心地抬起箱子,以免伤到腰。
keep clear of ⋯: Keep clear of the wet paint on the wall until it is completely dry.
墙上的油漆没完全干之前,不要靠近。
good morning: Good morning, class! Please open your books and turn to page ten.
同学们早上好!请打开书翻到第十页。
good afternoon: Good afternoon, everyone. Today we will discuss our plans for the school trip.
大家下午好。今天我们来讨论学校郊游的计划。
I'm = I am: I'm sorry I'm late; the traffic was terrible this morning.
对不起我迟到了,今天早上交通太糟糕了。
sit down: Sit down and make yourself comfortable while I make us some tea.
请坐下别拘束,我去给我们泡点茶。
stand up: The students stand up when the teacher enters the classroom every morning.
每天早上老师走进教室时,学生们都起立。
how old: How old is your little sister? She looks much taller than last year.
你妹妹多大了?她看起来比去年高多了。
colour (AmE color): What colour would you like to paint your bedroom, blue or green?
你想把卧室刷成什么颜色,蓝色还是绿色?
favourite (AmE favorite): Blue is my favourite colour because it always makes me feel calm and relaxed.
蓝色是我最喜欢的颜色,因为它总让我感到平静放松。
table tennis: We played table tennis after class, and Tom won three games in a row.
课后我们打了乒乓球,汤姆连赢了三局。
let's = let us: Let's take the bus to the museum instead of walking in the hot sun.
我们坐公交车去博物馆吧,别在大太阳底下走了。
What about ⋯?: What about a short break? We have been studying for two hours without stopping.
休息一小会儿怎么样?我们已经连续学习两个小时了。
photo (= photograph): She keeps a photo of her grandparents on the desk beside her bed.
她把一张祖父母的照片放在床边的书桌上。
on the left: The library is on the left, just past the tall office building.
图书馆在左边,就在那座高高的办公大楼过去一点。
on the right: You will see the bus stop on the right, opposite the small food shop.
你会看到公交车站就在右边,在小食品店的对面。
theatre (AmE theater): We went to the theatre last night and enjoyed a wonderful play about family life.
我们昨晚去了剧院,看了一出关于家庭生活的精彩话剧。
television (= TV): He watches television for an hour every evening after finishing his homework.
他每天晚上做完作业后看一小时电视。
how many: How many students are there in your class this term?
这学期你们班有多少名学生?
a lot of: There were a lot of people waiting outside the shop for the big sale.
店外有很多人等着参加大减价。
lab (= laboratory): The students put on their safety glasses before entering the science lab.
学生们进入科学实验室之前戴上了护目镜。
have got: I have got two tickets for the concert, so you can come with me tonight.
我弄到了两张音乐会的票,所以你今晚可以跟我一起去。
too much: Eating too much sugar is not healthy for your teeth or your body.
吃太多糖对你的牙齿和身体都不健康。
How about ⋯?: How about a cup of hot chocolate before we start our walk?
我们出发散步之前先来一杯热巧克力怎么样?
be good for: Eating fresh vegetables every day is good for your health and your memory.
每天吃新鲜蔬菜对你的健康和记忆力都有好处。
be bad for: Staying up late is bad for your eyes and makes you tired the next day.
熬夜对你的眼睛不好,还会让你第二天很疲倦。
a bit: I'm a bit tired today because I didn't sleep well last night.
我今天有点累,因为昨晚没睡好。
get fat: If you always eat late at night, you may get fat more easily.
如果你总是深夜吃东西,就更容易发胖。
maths (AmE math): She finds maths difficult sometimes, but she never gives up practising it.
她有时觉得数学很难,但她从不放弃练习。
PE (= physical education): We have PE twice a week, and my favourite activity is playing basketball.
我们每周上两次体育课,我最喜欢的活动是打篮球。
